description: The current value of one indicator, its zone, the methodology version and the normalised components with their weights. Components are given as a score on a 0–100 scale; the answer carries no raw input values. A missing component is marked with the status absent — that is absence, not zero.

spec_id.description: Indicator identifier from list_indicators, e.g. afgi.

name: get_indicator
title: Indicator: value and components
